findings.evidence: Primary navigation menu present at #nav with two links (Plan a trip, Accessibility). No breadcrumb trail, sitemap link, or search form visible. Link to 'accessibility improvements list' in content and footer links (Privacy, Terms) are not site-navigation mechanisms for locating this page within a multi-page site.
findings.fix: Add one of: a breadcrumb trail for hierarchical navigation, a sitemap link, or a site-wide search form.
findings.violation: Page provides only one navigation mechanism (primary menu); lacks breadcrumb trail, sitemap, or search form. Reader landing from search results has no way to locate related pages except by knowing to use the navigation menu.

findings.evidence: Input #promo at line 67 has aria-invalid="true". Error text at line 68 in span #s3-form-promo-error reads 'Enter a 6 character code using letters and numbers only.' and carries aria-live="polite", but the input element has no aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" attribute to create the programmatic association.
findings.fix: Add aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" to the input#promo element to programmatically link it to the error message.
findings.violation: Input field marked as invalid with aria-invalid="true" carries no programmatically associated error message via aria-describedby, so a screen-reader user focusing on the field does not automatically receive the error description.
